note: Shady, wooded modern campground on three loops (A, B, C) on spring-fed Fortune Lake, part of the Fortune Lakes Chain; CCC-era park with a swim beach, the chain's only public boat launch and a 2-mile nature trail. One of the few state parks that let ORVs ride between the campground and nearby trails (entering and leaving only). Sites #71-122 were renumbered after a new toilet/shower building and repaved roads, so check site numbers. --Claude
